drafted_from: Three independent accounts of a paid first result followed by optional continuity. Pricing disclosure, explicit opt-in and test boundaries are draft safeguards. Examples are invented.
start_here: Help me plan a one-time bicycle repair session and decide whether to offer optional support afterward.
no_lists_because: The workflow turns the information provided into a planning draft, without reading or changing subscriptions or stored lists.
instructions: Describe the first paid result and what ends that purchase.
Give evidence of a separate, recurring need or leave recurring terms out.
Read the draft terms and proposed later test without selling or enrolling anyone.

worked_examples.title: Separate recurring help
worked_examples.ask: Plan the first repair session and an optional ongoing check.
worked_examples.given: Invented scope, ending point, one-time price and separate evidence of repeat need.
worked_examples.hands_back: A one-time purchase and an optional separately accepted service with full terms.

plan-the-first-purchase-and-decide-what-.customer_outcome: Complete a safety check and repair one fault

first_purchase.result: Complete a safety check and repair one fault
first_purchase.ends_when: The session and safety checklist are complete

remaining_need.evidence_or_gap: Invented fixture: several volunteers asked about help for new faults after repair.

small_test.test: Show the terms to willing volunteers in a later approved test.
small_test.measure: Ask what they would pay and when each service ends.
small_test.stop_if: Stop if people confuse the one-time price with recurring billing.

ongoing_terms.scope: One optional guided check for a new fault per billing interval.
ongoing_terms.how_to_stop: Cancel before the next billing date.

worked_examples.title: No ongoing purchase
worked_examples.ask: Plan the session when no recurring need is observed.
worked_examples.given: An invented guided repair with a defined end and no observed continuing need.
worked_examples.hands_back: A one-time plan and test only, without recurring terms.
